bin_weight: overlap of exact modulus interval with midpoint cells of fixed mu nodes, normalized to unit total

template.phases: MS, subgiant and RGB; report visible stages at each node
template.native_transfer: if a direct native theoretical table is unavailable, fit a predeclared color-dependent relation from strict same-star overlap, exclude 0.8deg known-system regions, validate on native held-out cluster CMD; retain transfer uncertainty and support

sample.quality: original strict grz error<0.10mag and optical/mask admission
sample.ownership: original native boundary and measured ID overrides
sample.lower_snr: count separately with original complete photometry state and sampled prediction status

smoothing.formula: smooth(counts)/smooth(area); signed density minus 5deg count/area background

sequence.template: fixed native old metal-poor literature relation, no system zero-point fit
sequence.roles: M5/M13/M30/GD1 used as test systems with prior development ancestry retained

balance.method: fixed clipped propensity overlap weighting with cubic terms in continuous observables and native; refit each sky bootstrap

noise.primary: replay old IDs, donor choices and standard-normal realizations, pass max(original,donor) error
noise.secondary: whole-imaging strict native color/depth-matched donor library with reapplied quality and model support

power.branch_mass: before observed selection, joint branch-component weights times acceptance

local_filter.null_scope: independent available blank ribbons through identical complete local peak scan, archive repeated-field reuse

native_transfer.validation_rule: fixed separate modulo-5 hash role; report median and NMAD band residual; support restricted to calibration color envelope plus 0.05mag
